answer: Give every identity a terrace of distinct on-chain history: to earn standing, an agent must show a trail of real transactions with many different counterparties, each one a separate inlet of value that no other identity shares. A lone honest agent builds its terrace naturally over time, but a farm of clones must fabricate a thousand separate histories, and each new counterparty costs real fees and real counterparties, so like a sparrow that can only nest in one place, one history berths one identity and overlapping trails collapse the whole flock at once.
